title: Reading Drill — A Camera for Recording Clay Models
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Camera for Recording Clay Models
passages.body:
**A** A studio wanted pictures of unfinished sculptures so students could see how their ideas changed. It fixed the camera to a short stand to keep the viewing angle constant.

**B** Photographs taken after dark had a different colour from daylight images. The instructor put a grey reference card next to each model so colours could be compared later.

**C** Students chose which images to include in their portfolios. They could also write a short note explaining why they had removed or added part of a model.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: It fixed the camera to a short stand to keep the viewing angle constant.
